paragraphs.text: The Visceral Sea is a huge body of water separating the Terisian Isles and the Domains .

The Visceral Sea is part of the Dominarian ocean that lies east of the Terisian Isles (former Terisiare ), and west of the Domains . The Visceral Sea runs along the east coast of New Argive , and it connects to the Videnthian Sea in the north and the Shattered Sea in the southwest.
